property.name: SupportedDiagnostics
property.summary: Gets the complete set of tool-manifest diagnostics supported by the analyzer.

method.name: Initialize
method.summary: Initializes analyzer execution and registers the symbol-analysis pipeline for candidate tool types.

method.name: InitializeCompilation
method.summary: Registers compilation-scoped symbol analysis for named types in the current compilation.

method.name: AnalyzeNamedType
method.summary: Analyzes one named type symbol and reports any shared tool-manifest diagnostics that apply to it.
